verdict.rationale: Checkout.com uses AI for payment optimization, so asking whether customer data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documented opt-out, data-use policy, or training exclusion control. The community items concern a data breach, not AI training, and are not relevant here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
